headline: Goldman Sachs drops new warning on interest rate hikes
triage_reason: Goldman Sachs drops new warning on interest rate hikes
snippet: Stock market investors are heading into CPI week with a familiar playbook. The hope is that inflation cools off further and the Fed stays on hold, with robust earnings taking over as the next driver of the S&P 500 . For perspective, the S&P 500 recently traded near 7,575 , up about 10.7% year to date, according to Yahoo Finance , indicating the market has held up despite a remarkably choppy period. Earnings, in particular, have moved the needle, helping the market remain resilient amid the AI boom. However, according to a Goldman Sachs note cited by Seeking Alpha , strategist Ben Snider argues that stocks could face near-term pressure if interest rate hikes return to the conversation, even as corporate profits remain the bigger long-term force behind the market. Markets still see only a limited chance of a hike this month, but the path beyond that is less settled. That leaves a ton of tension for investors, even though the rally still has earnings support; one hawkish shift from the Fed might test how much of the risk market could absorb. The Fed risk hiding inside the S&P 500 rally The S&P 500 has held up as investors have relied on a familiar clean story, but that only holds if rate expectations are contained. On top of that, earnings have continued to impress, with Q2 expectations jumping following a superb Q1 showing. More AI: The new Chinese AI model rattling U.S. tech investors Anthropic restores access to Mythos 5 for select organizations SoftBank CEO offers stinging critique of Musk’s AI bet In fact, FactSet says analysts and companies were “more optimistic than normal” heading into Q2 earnings season, and that estimated S&P 500 Q2 earnings were higher than at the start of the quarter . It also says Q2 earnings growth is expected to be above 20% for the second straight quarter. Nevertheless, if interest rates rise, earnings alone may not be enough to justify further gains in the market. Today’s market is much more exposed to financing costs, as AI investments have been the primary drivers of earnings and stock market valuations. History explains why the gap matters. Goldman found that the S&P 500 has fallen about 2% on average in the three months after the start of the past seven Fed hiking cycles. In 1997, even a single quarter-point hike coincided with a roughly 10% drop before stocks recovered. The acquisition strengthens India's energy future and industrial competitiveness.

headline: Chembur Tree Collapse Probe Clears BMC Officials, Fines Contractors ₹5 Lakh And ₹2 Lakh
triage_reason: BMC officials cleared; contractors fined ₹5 Lakh and ₹2 Lakh after tree collapse probe.
snippet: Mumbai: In its investigation report of the Chembur tree collapse incident, which killed 11-year old Vihan Shrivastav, the commitee has acquitted garden department official and road engineers, finding that there is no evidence of any fault on the part of the garden department and roads department in the mishap. The probe commitee concluded that the contractors appointed for tree safety and road maintenance/supervision failed to take sufficient precautions and should be fined Rs 5 and Rs 2 lakh, respectively. The two member committee, consisting of deputy municipal commissioners Purshottam Malwade and Shahank Bhore, formed in the aftermath of the tree collapse mishap, also stated 25 measures to be taken to prevent such incidents in future and three recommendations. It was on June 30, that a 60-year old roadside Peepal tree uprooted and crashed on a bus of Universal High School on Road number 11, Chembur East, carrying 13 children. One student lost his life in the mishap, while four others sustained injuries. Following the uproar after the unfortunate incident, municipal commissioner Ashwini Bhide suspended M-West ward (Chembur) assistant superintendent of gardens Jagdish Bhoir, sub-engineer of roads Arun Munde and assistant engineer of roads Yogesh Parte, for prima facie negligence. The investigation committee formed in the aftermath was directed to submit its report within eight days, which ended last Wednesday. Findings of the inquiry committee: BMC and Garden department not at fault BMC's garden Department has inspected the relevant area from time to time and pre-monsoon trees were pruned as required. Also, the work of the storm water drain (SWD) near the relevant tree at Chembur was underway between January 2025 and March 2025 and the gardens Department had informed the Roads Department about these works from time to time. Therefore, the committee has stated in the report that there is no evidence of any fault on the part of the gardens Department in the accident. It further states that while working on the SWD next to the tree, it was found that the tree was in the SWD, which was being obstructed. Alternatively, the possibility of water stagnation could not be ruled out there. Therefore, in order to maintain the continuity of the SWD for proper drainage of rainwater and to save the tree, the Roads Department constructed the SWD keeping a safe distance from the tree. Thus, it is observed that the Roads Department has taken proper care in the said case. T

headline: ED Seeks Spain's Assistance In ₹800 Crore OctaFX Probe, Targets Assets Linked To Pavel Prozorov
triage_reason: India's ED seeks Spain's help in an ₹800 crore OctaFX investigation targeting assets linked to Pavel Prozorov.
snippet: Mumbai, July 13, 2026: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has sent a letter of request to Spain regarding properties allegedly owned by Pavel Prozorov, the alleged mastermind behind the online forex trading platform OctaFX, seeking records and documents related to shell companies and further evidence against him. ED Seeks Assistance From Spain OctaFX is accused of cheating investors of over Rs 800 crore through its Indian subsidiary. The ED is probing alleged money laundering by the firm and its promoter, Prozorov, a Russian national presently residing in Barcelona, Spain. The ED claimed that the investigation further revealed that several entities incorporated in the Kingdom of Spain, including M/s Amber Soluciones (AS) and M/s Mercats City SL, played a significant role in the functioning of the OctaFX network. It further revealed that substantial digital infrastructure, servers, financial records and other evidence relevant to the present investigation are situated within the Kingdom of Spain. Further, the ED has identified several movable and immovable properties situated in Spain that are beneficially owned by Prozorov and entities under his control. Properties Worth Crores Attached The ED claimed that in December 2024, 19 immovable properties situated in Spain, having an aggregate value of approximately Rs 41.73 crore, were provisionally attached. Subsequently, in July 2025, three movable and two immovable properties situated in Spain, having an aggregate equivalent value of approximately Rs 131.45 crore, were provisionally attached. Also Watch: OctaFX Mastermind Pavel Prozorov Nabbed By Spanish Police; ED Attaches Cryptos Worth ₹2,385 Crore Besides, in September 2025, cryptocurrency assets valued at approximately USD 27,07,16,113, beneficially owned by Prozorov and presently under the control of the Spanish Guardia Civil, were provisionally attached. Hence, the ED requires the assistance of Spain in executing the attachment of these assets and collecting further evidence against Prozorov and his shell companies. headline: Palghar District Warns Strict Action Against Negligent BLOs Over Electoral Roll Revision
triage_reason: Palghar district warns of strict action against negligent BLOs over electoral roll revision.
snippet: Palghar, Maharashtra: The Palghar district administration has warned that strict action will be taken against Booth Level Officers (BLOs) found negligent or delaying work under the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, being conducted as per the directions of the Election Commission of India (ECI). SIR Exercise Commenced June 30 The Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise commenced on June 30, 2026, with BLOs carrying out door-to-door visits to distribute and collect Enumeration Forms (EFs) from eligible voters. According to the district administration, 27.65 per cent of the Enumeration Form distribution has been completed across Palghar district so far. Constituency-wise progress stands at Dahanu (39%), Vikramgad (88%), Palghar (61%), Boisar (8%), Nalasopara (2%) and Vasai (7%). Heavy Rainfall Slows Progress Officials said that the pace of work in Boisar, Nalasopara and Vasai was significantly affected over the past 8–10 days due to heavy rainfall and flooding in several parts of the district, particularly in Vasai, Virar and Nalasopara. The administration has also received complaints alleging that some BLOs were accepting Enumeration Forms at schools or other public places through camps, instead of conducting door-to-door visits, and that there were concerns about officials acting on the instructions or influence of political representatives and other individuals. Fresh Instructions Issued to Officials In response, the district administration has issued fresh instructions to all Electoral Registration Officers (EROs), Assistant Electoral Registration Officers (AEROs), supervisors and BLOs, reiterating that all activities under the SIR programme must be carried out strictly in accordance with the Election Commission of India’s guidelines, rules and directions. The administration has made it clear that BLOs must not participate in or conduct any work at camps organised by political parties, nor should they perform any election-related duties under the instructions, pressure or influence of elected representatives, political office-bearers or any other individual. House-to-House Visits Mandated Instead, BLOs have been directed to follow the prescribed procedure by conducting house-to-house visits, distributing Enumeration Forms, collecting completed forms, carrying out verification and mapping, and ensuring every eligible voter is covered under the revision process. Apple stock remains largely unaffected at $4.63 trillion market cap with 16.2% year-to-date gains as investors await discovery and earnings on July 30, 2026. Cramer’s take was that this lawsuit carries weight because Apple rarely files them. “There are a lot of people who feel that the Apple lawsuit is heavyweight , because it’s not the kind of thing that Apple typically does. snippet: Mumbai, July 13, 2026: The investigation into the NESCO drug case has revealed that two consignments of MDMA (Ecstasy) pills allegedly arrived in India from Germany, concealed in parcels declared as dresses. The first parcel reached India on February 2 and was sent to an address in Ulhasnagar via Dubai. The police claimed that nearly 3,000 MDMA pills were concealed inside a dress. A second parcel containing around 1,000 pills allegedly arrived in March 2026 through Delhi before reaching Mumbai. Police said a total of 4,000 Ecstasy pills were smuggled through the two consignments, both transported by an American courier company. The parcels were allegedly received by Dipesh Hemwani in Ulhasnagar and later handed over to accused Ayush Sahitya. His hotel expenses were allegedly paid by accused Mahesh Khemlani. headline: 'Charcoal Is A Polluting Fuel': MPCB; HC Refuses Relief To Bombay Charcoal Merchants Association
triage_reason: High Court refuses relief to Bombay Charcoal Merchants Association
snippet: Mumbai, July 13, 2026: The Maharashtra Pollution Control Board (MPCB) informed the Bombay High Court on Monday that charcoal, which is widely used in furnaces at hotels, restaurants and bakeries, is a polluting fuel that emits toxic gases. HC Declines Interim Relief Taking note of the submission, a bench of Justice Ajay Gadkari and Justice Kamal Khata refused to grant any interim relief to charcoal traders and establishments using the fuel. The court was hearing an intervention application filed by the Bombay Charcoal Merchants Association (BCMA), contending that it was not heard before the order was passed against it. The application was filed last year in a suo motu (on its own) public interest litigation initiated by the High Court in relation to increasing air pollution in the city. Following the application, in March last year, the High Court asked the MPCB to consider the points raised by the association. MPCB Defends Stand During the hearing on Monday, Senior Advocate Ashutosh Kumbhakoni, appearing for the MPCB, submitted the Board's report stating that charcoal emits carbon monoxide, methane and black carbon, making it hazardous and contributing to air pollution. The petitioners argued that it was not financially viable for all hotels and restaurants to switch to LPG. They also pointed out that during the recent war-like situation, gas shortages had forced many establishments to rely on coal and charcoal to continue operations. Maintaining that charcoal is not a polluting fuel, they sought permission to file an additional affidavit. Unconvinced, the bench asked: "What will you achieve by filing an additional affidavit? Will it reduce air pollution?" Justice Khata observed that if the MPCB had concluded that charcoal emitted toxic gases and avoiding its use would reduce pollution, there was no reason to object. He added that the government had taken a policy decision keeping the larger public interest in mind. Court Questions Association The court was informed that a high-level committee constituted by the High Court had held 22 meetings on the issue and submitted a preliminary report along with four additional reports. Pursuant to an earlier court order, the MPCB had also heard the petitioners. Kumbhakoni said they had remained absent from one of those meetings. headline: MHADA Directs Hearing Against Developer Over Pending Rehab Flat, Transit Rent Complaint At Lokshahi Din
triage_reason: MHADA directs hearing against developer over pending rehab flat and rent complaint
snippet: Mumbai, July 13, 2026: The Maharashtra Housing and Area Development Authority (MHADA) on Monday heard two applications during its 19th Lokshahi Din, with one case involving a redevelopment project in south Mumbai where a resident alleged that he is yet to receive a rehabilitation flat despite the project having commenced years ago. MHADA Hears Public Grievances The public grievance hearing was held at MHADA headquarters in Bandra (East) under the chairmanship of MHADA Vice President and Chief Executive Officer Sanjeev Jaiswal. One of the applications was filed by Deepak Sonawale, a resident of Building No. 18, a cessed building on Fitwala Road at Elphinstone Road. Sonawale told the authority that the Mumbai Building Repairs and Reconstruction Board had issued no-objection certificates (NOCs) to the developer in 2006 and 2009 to undertake the redevelopment of the building. According to the complaint, despite the redevelopment process moving ahead, the developer has not allotted him a rehabilitation tenement. Sonawale also alleged that the developer has failed to pay the monthly transit rent and has not executed the Permanent Alternate Accommodation Agreement (PAAA). Developer To Be Summoned After hearing the matter, Jaiswal directed MHADA officials to summon the developer for a hearing. He said appropriate directions would be issued to ensure that the developer fulfils the resident's legitimate claims, including allotment of the rehabilitation flat, payment of pending transit rent and execution of the Permanent Alternate Accommodation Agreement. headline: 티앤씨재단, 복지 종사자 치유 지원 성료
triage_reason: T&CC Foundation completes support for welfare workers' healing
snippet: 티앤씨재단은 아동·청소년 복지 현장 종사자 20명을 대상으로 한 맞춤형 지원사업 '2026 힐러스힐어스(Healers, Heal Us!)'를 성료했다고 14일 밝혔다. 올해로 3회차를 맞이한 이 사업은 타인을 위해 헌신하는 복지 종사자들이 자신의 삶과 소중한 관계를 돌아볼 수 있도록 기획한 재단의 대표적 공감 프로젝트다. 이번 사업은 기존의 단체 교육이나 정해진 일정에서 벗어나 참가자가 직접 여행 시기와 동선을 구성하는 개별 맞춤형 방식으로 진행됐다. 재단은 항공권과 숙박, 현지 이동 수단 등을 전폭 지원했으며 참가자들은 제주 포도뮤지엄의 '우리 이토록 작은 존재들' 전시를 관람하며 예술을 통한 내면 성찰의 시간을 가졌다. 현장 종사자들은 이번 여행을 통해 일과 가정의 균형을 찾고 가족의 지지를 확인하는 성과를 거뒀다. 청주 서부종합사회복지관 신보미 사회복지사는 평소 챙기지 못했던 자녀와 시간을 보내며 자신의 직업을 소개하는 기회를 가졌다. 신 복지사는 "아이가 엄마가 사회복지사라서 좋다고 말해준 순간이 가장 행복했다"며 직업적 보람을 다시 확인했다고 전했다. 강화군드림스타트 구본경 사회복지사는 이번 지원을 '환대와 인정'의 경험으로 정의했다. 그는 사회복지사만을 위한 독립적인 지원과 치유자로서의 가치를 인정받는 기회가 흔치 않음을 강조하며, 재단의 배려가 현장을 살아갈 큰 힘이 됐다고 설명했다. 군산청소년수련관 강민주 청소년지도사는 온전한 휴식을 통해 마음의 여유를 되찾았으며, 본인이 행복해야 청소년들에게도 건강한 에너지를 전할 수 있다는 진리를 체감했다고 밝혔다. 티앤씨재단은 참가자들이 각자의 방식으로 관계를 회복하고 현장으로 돌아갈 힘을 얻었기를 기대한다고 밝혔다. 비지니스코리아 허성수 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 한국콜마, 자립준비청년 홀로서기 5년째 동행…"실무 교육부터 제품 개발까지"
triage_reason: Korea Kolmar supports self-reliant youth for five years with training and product development
snippet: 한국콜마가 홀로서기를 시작하는 자립준비청년들의 실질적인 자생력을 높이기 위해 5년째 후원 활동을 지속하고있다. 한국콜마는 지난 13일 서울 서초구 종합기술원에서 자립준비청년 지원을 위한 후원금 3700만원을 전달했다고 밝혔다. 이번 후원금은 재단법인 밴드를 통해 자립청년후원 사회적기업인 소이프스튜디오에 전달되어 청년들의 교육과 자립 기반 마련에 쓰일 예정이다. 전달식에는 최현규 한국콜마 대표이사와 고대현 소이프스튜디오 대표, 하정은 재단법인 밴드 이사장 등이 참석해 협력 의지를 다졌다. ▲ 지난 13일 한국콜마 종합기술원에서 열린 자립준비청년 지원을 위한 후원금 전달식에서 최현규 한국콜마 대표이사(가운데)와 고대현 소이프스튜디오 대표(오른쪽), 하정은 재단법인 밴드 이사장(왼쪽)이 기념사진을 촬영하고 있다. 자립준비청년은 만 18세가 되어 아동양육시설 등 보호 체계를 떠나 홀로 생계를 책임져야 하는 이들을 가리킨다. 한국콜마는 이들이 겪는 경제적 어려움과 정서적 고립감을 해소하고자 지난 2022년부터 꾸준히 지원 사업을 펼치고 있다. 현재까지 총 54명의 청년이 한국콜마의 장학금 혜택을 받으며 학업과 자립 준비에 전념했다. 한국콜마의 지원책 중 가장 눈에 띄는 대목은 화장품 업계 진출을 희망하는 청년들을 위한 맞춤형 교육 프로그램이다. 소이프스튜디오와 협력해 운영하는 디자인 아카데미는 청년들에게 전문적인 디자인 기술과 실무 노하우를 전수한다. 교육 과정을 수료한 청년들은 실제 산업 현장에서 쓰이는 역량을 습득하며 취업 경쟁력을 확보하고 있다. 실제 성과물도 도출됐다. 아카데미를 통해 실무 역량을 쌓은 청년들은 한국콜마 연구진과 공동으로 '하이드라 선세럼' 개발 프로젝트에 참여했다. 제품의 최종 디자인을 맡은 청년 디자이너에게는 별도의 장학금이 지급됐으며, 해당 제품은 향후 자립준비청년 지원 사업의 중요성을 알리는 홍보 수단으로 활용될 계획이다. 한국콜마 관계자는 "사회에 첫발을 내딛는 청년들이 두려움 없이 안정적으로 정착할 수 있도록 돕는 것이 기업의 역할"이라며 "앞으로도 자립준비청년들의 수요를 반영한 다양한 방식의 지원 프로그램을 확대해 나갈 방침이다"라고 강조했다. 비지니스코리아 허성수 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

triage_reason: Ottogi launches 'Chicken Soup Noodle' with nostalgic Dongdaemun market vibe
snippet: ㈜오뚜기는 13일 동대문 닭한마리 골목의 시초가 된 닭칼국수의 든든한 한 끼를 제품화했다고 밝혔다. 제품의 핵심은 정통 골목의 맛을 살린 국물과 면발의 조화에 있다. 진한 닭육수를 베이스로 야채의 감칠맛을 더했으며, 마늘과 후추의 은은한 향신미를 살려 개운하면서도 칼칼한 끝맛을 완성했다. 자칫 느끼할 수 있는 고기 육수의 단점을 보완해 한국인이 선호하는 시원한 맛을 강조한 셈이다. 면발은 시중 칼국수 전문점 수준의 규격을 적용해 부드럽고 쫄깃한 식감을 극대화했다. 특히 면 자체에 치킨과 마늘 풍미를 입혀 국물과의 일체감을 높였으며, 닭고기와 감자, 파 등 큼직한 건더기를 포함해 원물의 식감을 살리는 데 주력했다. 오뚜기가 이번 신제품을 기획한 배경에는 '로컬 맛집'을 찾는 MZ세대와 외국인 관광객의 소비 트렌드가 자리 잡고 있다. 유명 맛집의 메뉴를 집에서 즐기려는 수요가 늘어나면서 기업들은 지역 특색을 담은 간편식(HMR) 개발에 박차를 가하는 추세다. 오뚜기 관계자는 "동대문 골목의 따뜻한 정과 든든한 한 끼를 집에서도 간편하게 즐길 수 있도록 구현한 제품"이라고 설명했다. 이어 "앞으로도 전국 각지의 로컬 미식과 K-푸드의 매력을 간편식으로 선보이며 소비자들에게 더욱 다양한 미식 경험을 제공하겠다"고 전했다. 비지니스코리아 김황민 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: Michigan health officials identify ‘potential source’ of parasite outbreak
triage_reason: Michigan health officials identify potential source of parasite outbreak.
snippet: Authorities said inquiry into cyclosporiasis outbreak was continuing but early results pointed to salad greens and lettuce What is cyclosporiasis, the parasitic illness causing ‘explosive’ diarrhea? State health officials in Michigan said on Monday they have identified lettuces and salad greens as a “potential source” of the thousands of cases of cyclosporiasis – a parasitic infection that causes “watery diarrhea”, loss of appetite and weight loss. In a statement, the Michigan department of health and human services said the investigation is still continuing, but early results “point to lettuce or salad greens as a potential source for this outbreak”, though officials also cautioned it is too early to rule out other food sources. headline: Trump Reinstates the Iran Blockade and Demands a 20% Toll as America Becomes Hormuz’s “Guardian”
triage_reason: Trump reinstated the Iran blockade and demanded a 20% toll on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz
snippet: The post Trump Reinstates the Iran Blockade and Demands a 20% Toll as America Becomes Hormuz’s “Guardian” appeared first on 24/7 Wall St. . Trump reinstated U.S. Navy blockade on Iranian shipping in Strait of Hormuz and proposed 20% toll on cargo transiting the waterway, per CNBC's Megan Casella. Blockade follows Iran deescalation framework collapse; roughly 20% of global oil supply flows through Strait of Hormuz before February military action. The 20% cargo toll introduces unprecedented legal and commercial questions for shipping insurers, refiners, and the LNG complex relying on frictionless Hormuz transit. This lithium producer surpassed a $1B private valuation, joining some of America's most powerful startups. Now you can invest in EnergyX alongside global giants like General Motors, but only through July 16. (sponsor) President Trump has reversed the last surviving piece of the Iran de-escalation framework, reinstating a U.S. Navy blockade on Iranian shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and proposing a 20% toll on all cargo transiting the waterway to reimburse the United States for the cost of policing it. CNBC correspondent Megan Casella walked viewers through the Truth Social announcement on a Monday morning CNBC segment , framing it as both a policy reversal and an unprecedented commercial claim on one of the world’s most important chokepoints. Trump Wants the United States to Become the “Guardian” of Hormuz Casella summarized the two-part announcement: “The President says he’s reinstating the blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. headline: [개장 시황] 코스피, 6,800선 안팎 극심한 혼조 출발…원-달러 환율은 1,500육박
triage_reason: KOSPI opened around 6,800 with mixed trading and the won‑dollar near 1,500.
snippet: 14일 서울 중구 하나은행 본점 딜링룸 전광판에 원-달러 환율, 코스피와 SK하이닉스, 삼성전자 주가가 표시돼 있다. 중동발(發) 지정학적 긴장감 재고조와 인공지능(AI) 반도체 피크아웃(정점 통과) 논란이라는 초대형 악재가 글로벌 금융시장을 또다시 뒤흔들고 있다. 미국의 대(對)이란 해상 봉쇄 조치 방침과 호르무즈 해협 재봉쇄 예고가 전해지면서 국제유가가 폭등했고, 대외 환경에 취약한 국내 증시는 장 출발과 동시에 거센 하방 압력에 직면했다. 7월 14일 오전 9시 30분 현재 국내 증시는 심리적 지지선이었던 코스피 7,000선이 붕괴된 전날의 충격 여파를 이어받아 장 초반부터 극심한 변동성을 연출하고 있다. 위험자산 회피 심리가 극대화된 가운데 외국인과 기관 투자자의 차익 실현 물량이 지수를 압박하는 반면, 낙폭과대에 따른 저가 매수를 노린 개인 투자자들의 방어세가 맞부딪히는 양상이다. 코스피 6,800선 시험대, 코스닥도 800선 하회 지속 14일 유가증권시장(KOSPI)은 오전 9시 30분 기준 전 거래일(6,806.93) 대비 소폭 하락한 6,769.06을 기록하는 등 장 초반 6,800선을 경계로 치열한 공방을 벌이고 있다. 이날 코스피는 개장 직후 전일 대비 하락 출발하며 장중 한때 변동성을 키웠으나, 낙폭을 일부 만회하려는 시도가 이어지며 지지선 확보에 주력하는 모습이다. 전날 장중 낙폭이 8%를 넘어서며 사상 수차례 발동됐던 서킷브레이커(거래 일시정지)의 공포 분위기가 완전히 가시지 않은 탓에, 시장 참가자들의 투자 심리는 급격히 위축되어 있다. 특히 트럼프 미국 대통령이 교전을 재개한 이란을 향해 강경한 군사적·경제적 메시지를 쏟아내며 호르무즈 해협 통과 선박에 대한 20% 통행료 부과 방침을 밝힌 점이 국내 증시의 발목을 잡았다. 코스닥(KOSDAQ) 시장 역시 약세 흐름을 탈피하지 못하고 있다. 같은 시각 코스닥지수는 전 거래일 대비 하락세를 유지하며 790~800선 안팎에서 횡보 중이다. 시가총액 상위권 내 바이오 및 2차전지 기술주를 중심으로 글로벌 거시경제 불확실성에 따른 매물이 쏟아지며 하방 압력을 견디고 있다. 외인·기관 매도세 지속, 개인은 저가 매수세 유입 이날 장 출발 이후 투자 주체별 매매동향을 살펴보면 외국인과 기관의 동반 매도 기조가 장 초반부터 시장을 압박하고 있다. 외국인 투자자는 미국 뉴욕증시의 나스닥 지수가 1.55% 밀리는 등 기술주 중심의 투심 악화와 원·달러 환율 급등에 따른 환차손 우려로 장 초반부터 매도 우위를 나타내고 있다. 반도체 대형주를 중심으로 매물을 내놓으며 지수 반등을 제한하는 중이다. 기관 투자자는 금융투자와 투신을 중심으로 매도 물량을 출회하며 외국인과 함께 지수 하락을 견인하고 있다. 중동 리스크 장기화에 대비한 포트폴리오 리스크 관리 차원의 물량이 나오는 것으로 풀이된다. 반면 개인 투자자들은 이틀 연속 이어지는 급락 장세를 저가 매수의 기회로 판단, 적극적인 순매수로 대응하며 외인과 기관이 던진 물량을 받아내고 있다. 지수가 단기 과매도 구간에 진입했다는 인식이 확산되면서 대형주 위주의 매수세가 대거 유입되는 흐름이다. 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 프리장 급락 여파 속 본장 공방전 국내 증시의 향방을 가르는 반도체 투톱인 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스는 정규장 개장 전 시간외 거래(프리장)부터 각각 3~4%대 급락세를 연출하며 극심한 조정을 예고했다. 미국 증시에서 엔비디아를 비롯한 주요 반도체 종목들이 AI 산업 비관론과 공급망 불안 우려로 일제히 하락한 점이 고스란히 반영됐다. 개장 전 24만 원대까지 조정을 받았던 삼성전자는 본장 개장 이후에도 외국인 매도세가 집중되며 약세 흐름을 이어가고 있다. 전날 '30만전자' 타이틀을 반납한 이후 장 초반 가격 메리트를 느낀 개인의 매수세와 외인의 매도세가 치열하게 부딪치고 있다. 고대역폭메모리(HBM) 피크아웃 우려의 직격탄을 맞은 SK하이닉스 역시 장 초반 큰 폭의 하락세를 나타내며 주가 전선에 비상이 걸렸다. '200만닉스' 붕괴 이후 단기 기술적 반등을 노린 매수세가 일부 유입되고 있으나 대외 불확실성 탓에 상승 반전에는 난항을 겪고 있다. 반면 시가총액 상위권 중 일부 내수 업종과 화학, 섬유/의류 등 낙폭과대 업종 및 지정학적 수혜 우려가 반영된 일부 섹터는 소폭의 빨간불을 켜며 차별화된 흐름을 시도하고 있다. 그러나 LG에너지솔루션, 삼성바이오로직스 등 대부분의 대형 기술주들은 매크로 리스크 악화에 밀려 동반 약세를 감내하는 분위기다. 환율 1,500원선 육박, 유가 폭등에 가중되는 불안 증시의 가파른 변동성과 맞물려 서울 외환시장에서 원·달러 환율은 장 초반부터 급등세를 연출하며 1,490원대 후반에서 1,500원선 돌파를 시도하고 있다. 글로벌 외환시장에서 안전자산인 미국 달러화에 대한 선호 현상이 극대화된 결과다. 특히 서부텍사스산원유(WTI)와 브렌트유 등 국제 유가가 호르무즈 해협 봉쇄 리스크로 인해 하루 만에 9% 이상 폭등하며 각각 배럴당 78달러, 83달러선을 돌파한 점이 원화 가치를 강력하게 끌

headline: 한국타이어, 이탈리아 'A 디자인 어워드' 금상
triage_reason: Korea Tire won the gold award at Italy's A Design Award.
snippet: 한국타이어앤테크놀로지(이하 한국타이어는 이탈리아 'A 디자인 어워드 2026'에서 업사이클링 프로젝트 '리무브(re:move)'의 '브라다 업사이클링 시리즈'로 금상을 수상했다고 14일 밝혔다. 이번 수상의 핵심인 '리무브'는 타이어 성형 공정에서 발생하는 내피 소재인 '브라다(Bladder)'를 폐기하지 않고 새로운 자원으로 순환시키는 한국타이어의 대표적 ESG 프로젝트다. 고무 소재의 특성을 살리면서도 디자인적 요소를 가미해 산업 폐기물에 새로운 생명력을 불어넣는 작업에 집중하고 있다. 수상작인 '브라다 업사이클링 시리즈'는 서울대학교 순환디자인연구실 '디스코랩'과의 협업을 통해 탄생했다. 주요 품목으로는 ▲3D 프린팅 기술로 곡선미를 살린 업사이클 가구 ▲타이어 몰드를 재활용한 키네틱 월 형태의 업사이클 브릭 ▲수작업으로 제작한 라이프스타일 키링 등이 포함된다. 소재의 질감을 극대화하면서도 실용성을 갖춘 점이 심사위원들의 높은 점수를 이끌어냈다. 한국타이어는 앞서 리무브 프로젝트의 첫 결과물인 '업사이클 롱보드'는 세계 3대 디자인 상으로 꼽히는 '레드닷 디자인 어워드 2024'에서 본상을 수상했다. 이어 미국 '2025 그린 굿 디자인 지속가능성 어워드'에서도 성과를 냈다. 한국타이어는 "지속가능한 디자인 혁신은 미래 모빌리티 시대를 선도하기 위한 필수 과제"라며 "앞으로도 불용 소재의 자원화를 추진하며 글로벌 선도 타이어 기업으로서 ESG 경영을 실천해 나가겠다"고 강조했다. 비지니스코리아 허성수 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 롯데칠성·금호건설, 폭온열질환 예방 캠페인 전개
triage_reason: Lotte Chilsung and Kumho Construction launched a heat‑illness prevention campaign.
snippet: 롯데칠성음료가 여름철 기록적인 폭염에 노출된 건설현장 근로자들의 건강권을 확보하기 위해 민관 합동 온열질환 예방 활동에 나섰다. 롯데칠성음료는 지난 13일 경기도 오산시 벌음동 소재 '금호건설 오산세교 아테라 아파트' 건설현장에서 온열질환 예방 캠페인을 실시했다. 이번 행사에는 롯데칠성음료를 비롯해 고용노동부 평택지청, 안전보건공단 경기남부지사, 금호건설 관계자들이 대거 참석해 현장 안전 점검과 근로자 격려를 진행했다. 금호건설 관계자가 온열질환 예방 물품을 전달하는 모습. 롯데칠성음료는 현장 내 전용 부스를 마련하고 오전 11시부터 약 한 시간 동안 근로자 200여 명을 대상으로 집중 지원 활동을 펼쳤다. 땀으로 배출된 전해질을 보충할 수 있는 게토레이와 아이시스 생수, 이온분말을 제공하며 근로자들의 수분 섭취를 독려했다. 신체 온도를 즉각적으로 낮출 수 있는 기능성 물품도 전달했다. 쿨타월과 아이스 쿨팩, 쿨링 패치 등 현장에서 즉시 활용 가능한 냉감 용품을 배포해 근로자들이 작업 중에도 체온을 관리할 수 있도록 도왔다. 근로자들의 참여를 위해 폭염 대비 안전 수칙을 주제로 한 '플링코 게임' 이벤트를 하기도 했다. 게임 결과에 따라 경품을 차등 지급하며 현장 분위기를 고조시키는 동시에 건강 관리의 중요성을 각인시켰다. 금호건설 역시 이번 캠페인에 발맞춰 현장 내 안전 관리 강도를 높이고 있다. 기존에 운영하던 그늘 쉼터의 기능을 강화하고 롯데칠성음료로부터 지원받은 다양한 음료를 현장 곳곳에 비치했다. 근로자들이 작업 중 언제든 충분한 수분을 보충할 수 있는 환경을 조성해 혹서기 안전사고를 선제적으로 차단하겠다는 방침이다. 롯데칠성음료 관계자는 "건설현장은 폭염으로 인한 온열질환 위험이 가장 높은 곳 중 하나인 만큼 이번 활동이 근로자들의 안전을 지키는 실질적인 보탬이 되길 기대한다"고 밝혔다. 비지니스코리아 최문희 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 초고령사회 진입 앞두고 시니어 영양식 '뉴케어' 브랜드 평판 1위 등극
triage_reason: Senior nutrition brand 'NewCare' ranked top in reputation surveys.
snippet: 초고령사회 진입을 앞두고 시니어 전용 제품에 대한 소비자 관심이 높아지는 가운데 뉴케어 시니어영양식이 브랜드 평판 1위에 올랐다. 한국기업평판연구소는 지난 6월 14일부터 한 달간 시니어 제품 브랜드 30개에 대한 빅데이터 763만 1497개를 분석한 결과를 15일 발표했다. 이번 조사는 참여·소통·커뮤니티 지수 등 소비자들의 온라인 습관과 브랜드 소비 성향을 종합적으로 측정해 산출했다. 분석 결과에 따르면 뉴케어 시니어영양식은 브랜드평판지수 181만 6372를 기록하며 압도적인 1위를 기록했다. 이는 지난달과 비교해 42.30% 급등한 수치로, 참여지수와 소통지수 모두에서 높은 점수를 얻으며 시장 지배력을 강화했다. 반면 2위인 포낙 보청기와 3위 정성 성인기저귀는 각각 전월 대비 23.68%, 34.88% 하락하며 상위권 내에서도 희비가 엇갈렸다. 4위와 5위는 스타키 보청기와 시그니아 보청기가 각각 차지하며 보청기 브랜드의 강세를 입증했다. 이어 뷰티풀라이프 성인기저귀, 오티콘 보청기, 휴플러스 시니어 안마기 등이 상위권에 이름을 올렸다. 보청기 브랜드가 상위 10위권 내 5개를 차지하며 여전히 시니어 시장의 핵심 품목임을 보여준 반면, 영양식 브랜드의 약진은 '삶의 질'을 중시하는 소비 트렌드 변화를 반영한다. 전체적인 시장 지표를 살펴보면 브랜드 소비 지수는 전월 대비 8.61% 상승했으나 소통 지수는 24.97% 하락했다. 이는 소비자들이 제품을 실제 구매하는 행위는 늘었지만 온라인상에서의 정보 공유나 커뮤니티 활동은 다소 주춤해진 상태임을 시사한다. 전체 빅데이터 규모 역시 지난달보다 11.83% 줄어든 것으로 나타났다. 구창환 한국기업평판연구소 소장은 "뉴케어 시니어영양식이 브랜드 이슈와 소비자 참여를 이끌어내며 1위를 수성했다"며 "전체적인 브랜드 소통량은 줄었지만 실제 소비로 이어지는 참여 지수가 견고해 시니어 시장의 실질적 성장세는 지속될 것으로 보인다"고 분석했다. 비지니스코리아 이광수 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 서울 AI 허브서 빌더 166명 하루 29개 서비스 만들었다!
triage_reason: At Seoul AI Hub, 166 builders created 29 services in one day.
snippet: 서울 AI 허브는 글로벌 코딩 플랫폼 커서(Cursor)의 국내 커뮤니티 팀휴먼과 공동 개최한 해커톤에서 166명의 참가자가 단 하루 만에 29개의 서비스 프로토타입을 구현했다고 밝혔다. 지난달 27일 양재동 서울 AI 허브 메인센터에서 열린 이번 행사는 개발자뿐 아니라 기획자, 디자이너, 학생 등 다양한 직군이 참여해 AI와의 협업 가능성을 타진했다. 참가자의 90%가 해커톤 초심자였음에도 불구하고 실제 구동 가능한 서비스를 내놓으며 생성형 AI 기반 개발 문화의 확산을 입증했다. 미국, 몽골 등 5개국 이상의 글로벌 인재와 국내 15개 대학 연구진이 합류해 국경과 분야를 넘는 빌더 생태계의 면모를 보였다. 'Cursor Hackathon Seoul vol.3' 참가팀이 생성형 AI를 활용해 개발한 서비스를 발표하고 있다. 이번 해커톤의 핵심 동력은 생성형 AI를 개발 파트너로 삼는 '바이브 코딩(Vibe Coding)' 기법이다. 참가팀들은 AI 에이전트, 개인정보 보호, 금융, 리테일 등 다방면에서 혁신적인 도구를 선보였다. 짧은 시간 내에 복잡한 코드를 생성하고 오류를 수정하는 AI의 보조 덕분에 참가자들은 기술적 구현보다 서비스의 본질적인 가치와 사용자 경험에 집중할 수 있었다. 특히 서울시 공공데이터를 접목해 도시 문제를 해결하려는 시도들이 높은 평가를 받았다. 서울 열린데이터광장과 응급의료기관 API 등을 활용해 복지 혜택을 추천하거나 저시력자의 이동을 돕는 서비스가 대표적이다. 실시간 병원 안내와 공공 안전 서비스 등 시민 실생활과 밀착된 아이디어들이 구체적인 결과물로 도출됐다. 올해 신설된 '서울 AI 허브 특별상'은 AI 기반 복지 추천 서비스인 '받을지도' 팀에게 돌아갔다. 해당 팀에는 커서 AI 크레딧과 함께 서울 AI 허브 멤버십 가산점이 부여된다. 서울 AI 허브는 이번 성과를 바탕으로 글로벌 AI 커뮤니티와의 접점을 넓히고 인재 발굴에 박차를 가한다. 단순한 기술 교육을 넘어 빌더들이 서로 교류하며 아이디어를 빠르게 검증하는 개방형 혁신 플랫폼 역할을 수행한다는 구상이다. 유망한 프로젝트는 허브의 인프라를 통해 시장에 안착할 수 있도록 체계적인 육성 프로그램을 제공받는다. 변우석 서울 AI 허브 센터장은 "AI는 이제 개발 속도를 높이는 도구를 넘어 누구나 서비스를 창조하게 돕는 새로운 환경"이라며 생태계 조성의 중요성을 강조했다. 비지니스코리아 이송훈 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 오리온, 당 함량 1g대 '오!그래놀라 저당 카카오' 출시
triage_reason: Orion launched a low‑sugar granola bar with about 1 g of sugar.
snippet: 오리온은 14일 식사 대용식 브랜드 마켓오네이처의 신제품 '오!그래놀라 저당 카카오'를 출시했다고 밝혔다. 이번 제품은 식후 혈당 상승 억제에 도움을 줄 수 있다고 알려진 난소화성말토덱스트린을 함유한 기능성표시식품이다. 가장 눈에 띄는 대목은 압도적으로 낮은 당 함량이다. 한 그릇 섭취량인 30g 기준으로 당 함량을 1g대로 낮춰 소비자의 당 섭취 부담을 최소화했다. 제품 구성에서도 차별화를 꾀했다. 옥수수 가루를 튀겨낸 일반적인 콘플레이크를 전혀 사용하지 않는 대신 국산 쌀과 통밀, 귀리 등 통곡물을 두툼하게 뭉쳐 그래놀라 본연의 식감을 살렸다. 여기에 진한 카카오 풍미를 더해 저당 제품은 맛이 없다는 편견을 깨는 데 주력했다. 현재 오리온은 4가지 오트와 고식이섬유를 담은 '오!그래놀라 오트 통넛츠'를 비롯해 당 함량을 낮춘 '저당 통보리' 등 총 9종의 라인업을 운영 중이다. 오리온 관계자는 "이번 신제품은 혈당 밸런스를 챙기면서도 당 부담 없이 그래놀라를 즐기고 싶어 하는 소비자들을 위해 개발했다"며 "앞으로도 건강 트렌드에 발맞춰 영양 성분은 강화하고 맛은 유지한 다양한 기능성 제품을 지속적으로 선보일 계획"이라고 강조했다. 비지니스코리아 최문희 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 풀무원재단, 시니어 식생활 교육 성료
triage_reason: Pulmuone Foundation completed senior nutrition education program.
snippet: 풀무원재단이 시니어 계층의 건강 수명 연장을 위해 도입한 실천형 식생활 교육이 가시적인 성과를 거두며 종료됐다. 풀무원재단은 지난 5월부터 2개월간 공무원연금공단과 협력해 퇴직 공무원을 대상으로 진행한 '2026년 상반기 시니어 지속가능 식생활 교육'을 마무리했다고 14일 밝혔다. 이번 교육은 퇴직 후 생활 환경 변화로 식습관 관리가 필요한 시니어들에게 지속가능한 건강 관리법을 전파하기 위해 마련됐다. 13일 서울 강남구 공무원연금공단 서울지부에서 열린 올해 상반기 '시니어 지속가능 식생활 교육'의 성과공유회에서 교육 강사가 참가자들 앞에서 교육 성과에 대해 언급하고 있다. 재단은 교육의 실효성을 높이기 위해 연속혈당측정기(CGM)를 전격 도입했다. 참가자들은 2주간 기기를 착용하며 자신이 섭취한 음식과 식사 순서에 따라 혈당이 실시간으로 어떻게 변하는지 직접 확인했다. 핵심 실천 방안으로는 '거꾸로 211 식사법'이 제시됐다. 채소, 단백질, 통곡물을 2:1:1 비율로 구성하되 식이섬유가 풍부한 채소를 먼저 먹고 단백질, 탄수화물 순으로 섭취하는 방식이다. 이러한 식사 순서 조절은 혈당 급상승을 억제하고 포만감을 유지하는 데 효과적인 것으로 알려져 있다. 교육 결과 참가자들의 건강 지표는 눈에 띄게 개선됐다. 참가자 12명의 혈당변동계수(CV)를 분석한 결과, 교육 초기 평균 21.1%였던 수치가 종료 시점에는 17.2%로 3.9%포인트 하락했다. 신체 치수의 변화도 동반됐다. 참가자들의 평균 체중은 59.8kg에서 57.9kg으로 줄었으며, 허리둘레 역시 평균 79.8cm에서 77.0cm로 2.8cm 감소했다. 재단 측은 CGM을 통한 실시간 모니터링과 일대일 영양 상담이 결합하면서 참가자들이 스스로에게 맞는 식단과 습관을 찾아낸 결과라고 분석했다. 풀무원재단은 이번 성과를 바탕으로 시니어 지속가능 식생활 교육 과정을 체계화할 방침이다. 비지니스코리아 최문희 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

snippet: The post RSP’s Equal-Weight Trap: How a $10,000 Investment Lost $27,800 to Fees and Rebalancing Drag Over a Decade appeared first on 24/7 Wall St. . If you bought Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF ( NYSEARCA:RSP ) to diversify away from the “ Magnificent Seven ,” congratulations: you got the diversification. You also got a fee stack, a cash pile, and a rebalancing engine that has quietly cost long-term holders tens of thousands of dollars against a plain vanilla S&P 500 fund. What You’re Actually Paying RSP’s expense ratio sits at roughly 0.20% a year. On a $10,000 position, that is about $20 annually. Sounds trivial. It isn’t, because the cheapest cap-weighted mirror charges a fraction of that. Vanguard S&P 500 ETF ( NYSEARCA:VOO ) carries a net expense ratio of 0.03%, or $3 a year per $10,000. That is a fee gap that compounds every single year you hold the fund. Fees are the visible cost. The invisible one is the return gap. Over the past five years, RSP returned 53.18%. VOO returned 86% over the same window. Over ten years, RSP delivered 206.76% versus VOO’s 314.79%. A $10,000 stake in each on July 12, 2016 ended up in very different places by July 10, 2026, and the fee sheet only explains a sliver of the gap. The Part the Factsheet Doesn’t Highlight Start with cash drag. As of April 30, 2026, RSP held three short-term investment vehicles totaling roughly $3.59 billion, about 4.09% of net assets. That is billions of dollars sitting in money market sleeves inside an equity fund. In a rising market, cash lags stocks. That drag is not in the expense ratio. Next, rebalancing. RSP holds 508 positions and resets them toward equal weight every quarter. Every reset means selling winners and buying laggards across hundreds of names, which creates turnover, transaction cost, and taxable capital gains for investors in taxable accounts. The equal-weight mandate is also loose in practice. On the same date, Intel sat at 0.378% of net assets while Alphabet sat at just 0.106%. You are paying for equal weight and getting position sizes that drift between rebalances. Then there is the structural underweight to mega-caps. When Apple, Microsoft, NVIDIA, and Alphabet lead the market, RSP structurally can’t keep up. That showed up in the one-year comparison: RSP gained 17.25% in the year ending July 10, 2026, while VOO gained 22.04%. triage_reason: Investment suggestion article, no material news.
snippet: The post Two Income ETFs Retirees Can Buy Inside a Roth IRA to Generate Tax Free Cash for Life appeared first on 24/7 Wall St. . The Roth IRA is arguably one of the most powerful retirement accounts available because qualified withdrawals are completely tax free. For 2026, investors can contribute up to $7,500, while those age 50 and older can contribute $8,600 thanks to the catch-up contribution. Contributions can generally be withdrawn at any time without taxes or penalties because they were made with after-tax dollars. Investment gains, including dividends, interest, and capital appreciation, can also be withdrawn completely tax free provided the account has been open for at least five years and you’re at least age 59½ or disabled. Many younger investors use their Roth IRA primarily for long-term capital appreciation, and that’s a perfectly sensible approach. Retirees, however, may want to think differently. A Roth IRA can be an ideal place to hold higher-yielding but tax-inefficient investments that generate ordinary income, such as bond funds, REITs, and certain derivative-income ETFs. Here are two popular examples from JPMorgan Asset Management that fall into the last category. JPMorgan Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPI) The JPMorgan Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPI) is built around two complementary strategies. First, the managers actively select a portfolio of large-cap U.S. companies designed to produce returns similar to the S&P 500 but with lower overall volatility. The emphasis is on higher-quality, more defensive businesses rather than simply tracking the index. Second, roughly 15% of the portfolio is invested in equity-linked notes. These structured products replicate the payoff of a one-month out-of-the-money covered call strategy on the S&P 500, allowing JEPI to monetize index option premiums without writing covered calls directly on its stock holdings. The result is a thoughtful combination of lower-volatility equities and option income, all for a relatively modest 0.35% expense ratio. The drawback is taxes. Income generated through ELNs does not receive the favorable 60/40 tax treatment available to Section 1256 index options. Instead, much of JEPI’s distributions are taxed as ordinary income, making the fund relatively tax inefficient in a taxable brokerage account. headline: Vietnam boat tragedy: Cheaper travel packages raise safety concerns, say tour operators
triage_reason: Vietnam boat tragedy raises safety concerns but has no immediate financial impact on listed firms.
snippet: Bengaluru: After Indian tourists died after a boat capsized near an island off Vietnam’s Phu Quoc on Saturday, the promise of a cheaper holiday often comes with hidden risks. As adventure tourism gains popularity in India, safety measures such as insurance and operator accountability are frequently treated as optional extras rather than essentials. In a race to cut costs, tourists sometimes ask travel operators to exclude insurance from their packages, some city-based tour operators told DH. “A lot of tourism today is driven by social media. So, seeing social media prices, customers often ask us to break down the package price. When they hear the bill includes an insurance fee, they ask us to remove it, as they already have insurance. Often, people fail to realise the difference between medical and travel insurance,” said Mohan Hegde, manager at Nesara Tours. Fifteen Indian tourists killed after speedboat capsizes in Vietnam Many tour operators also keep adventure activities outside the itinerary to limit financial and legal liability. “Generally, as such activities are dependent on the weather, it doesn’t make sense to include them in the travel package. Instead, once the client reaches the destination, we recommend trusted adventure tour operators. In some cases, we also take them to the location of the activity, but we don’t make the bookings,” another tour operator said. Among the popular Indian tourist sites favoured by Bengalureans for adventure activities are Netrani Island, Malpe, Karwar, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Rishikesh, and Haridwar. For international tourism involving adventure activities, many prefer Bali, Indonesia, according to tour operators. “In many cases, there is also cost-cutting on incentive tours. In case of international trips, two parties are responsible for this — the local tour company and the Destination Management Company (DMC),” said Rohit Hangal, director, Sphere Travelmedia and Exhibitions. An incentive tour, an all-expense-paid corporate trip. On July 11, a speedboat carrying 32 Indian tourists and four local crew members capsized off Phu Quoc Island in Vietnam. The tourists were on a corporate-sponsored reward trip for Lava International.

headline: Rain deficit in Bengaluru brings summer-like heat as temperatures soar
triage_reason: Rain deficit and heat in Bengaluru is a weather report without financial implications.
snippet: Bengaluru: On Sunday, Bengaluru recorded a maximum temperature of 32 degrees Celsius, nearly 3.7 degrees Celsius higher than the normal temperature for July. This is also the highest temperature recorded in July after 2021 when a maximum temperature of 32.7 degrees Celsius was recorded. This July is also the second hottest in the last decade. According to an analysis by India Meteorological Department (IMD), the average normal maximum temperature for July is 28.3 degrees Celsius. However, this year, owing to poor rain, the temperatures have gone up significantly. “The southwest monsoon winds are weak and there has been no cloud formation. Poor monsoons are the major reason for the rise in temperature,” explained N Puviarasan, Scientist ‘F’ and head of the Meteorological Centre at IMD, Bengaluru. This monsoon season from June 1 to July 10, Bengaluru has recorded nearly 34% deficit rainfall. Light rain cools down Bengaluru, maximum temperature dips below 33°C under generally cloudy skies The situation might worsen in the next few days, officials opined. Bengaluru is likely to witness summer-like hot days. With no rain forecast for the next one week, IMD officials said the temperature might increase by another two to three degrees Celsius over the next few days. “At present, there are no systems that will support rainfall. No rains are expected for the next four to five days and as a result, temperature might increase even further,” Puviarasan explained. The minimum temperature in the city has also remained higher than normal. That means that the nights are also getting hotter this July. On Sunday, the minimum temperature stood at 21 degrees Celsius, 0.9 degrees Celsius higher than the normal minimum temperature for July.

Making a false declaration is punishable with imprisonment, fine, or both. snippet: The June 17 ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is over. U.S. forces bombed more than 80 targets inside Iran over the July 12-13 weekend. Iran's Revolutionary Guard responded by closing the Strait of Hormuz again. On July 13, President Donald Trump went on Truth Social and said the U.S. was putting the naval blockade back in place and charging every ship that uses the Strait a 20% toll on its cargo. Oil moved before anyone had time to read the full post. Brent crude was up nearly 8% to $82.03. West Texas Intermediate moved the same amount to $77.10. Just six vessels crossed the Strait in a 12-hour window on July 11. Before the fighting resumed, it was 18 to 22 a day, according to Al Jazeera . About 230 loaded oil tankers are sitting inside the Gulf right now with nowhere to deliver their cargo. White House's new Hormuz blockade and 20% oil shipping toll explained "The Hormuz Strait is OPEN , and will remain OPEN, with or without Iran. We are reinstating the THE IRANIAN BLOCKADE, so named because it is only stopping Iran's ships or customers from entering or leaving. All other countries will have fair and open use of the Strait," Trump wrote on Truth Social, as The Hill reported. He said the U.S. would now be called "THE GUARDIAN OF THE HORMUZ STRAIT" and would collect 20% on all cargo shipped through it. The blockade kicks in July 14 at 4 p.m. EST, according to Axios. It covers Iran's entire coastline, all ports, and oil terminals. Any ship entering or leaving those areas without U.S. authorization can be intercepted, boarded, and seized. The International Maritime Organization (IMO) said that's a problem. "There is no legal basis through which to introduce mandatory tolls simply to transit through a strait," the IMO told CNBC . Its 40-member council, which includes the U.S., said transit rights through international straits cannot be "threatened, impeded, denied, hampered, impaired or suspended." On July 13, U.S. Central Command said the Strait was open and U.S. forces were there to keep it that way, The Hill reported. Iran's IRGC, on the same day, said it was closed. Two militaries, two different answers, same waterway. President Trump told reporters as recently as July 8 that oil prices would come down and that the Iran war would "end very quickly." headline: Ron Johnson is full speed ahead on Reconciliation 3.0
triage_reason: Legislative agenda item without disclosed financial effect.
snippet: Sen. Ron Johnson doesn’t know when he will officially take over as chair of the Senate Budget Committee, a post left vacant by the sudden death Saturday of Sen. Lindsey Graham . But the Wisconsin Republican is wasting no time getting ready. “I've already met with Lindsey's staff this afternoon,” Johnson said soon after arriving at the Capitol on Monday. He acknowledged the gravity of his longtime colleague’s loss and said he understood the need to “take one step at a time.” But he also said he is hoping to quickly pick up where Graham left off on a new party-line budget reconciliation bill — something Johnson has advocated for more than a year and is now getting a fresh push from President Donald Trump. The president wants the legislation to send $350 billion to the Pentagon and enact a litany of other GOP priorities ahead of the midterm elections. While Graham was keen on delivering the defense funding by hook or by crook, Johnson is a veteran deficit hawk who told reporters Monday evening that identifying the maximum number of spending offsets “would certainly be one of my objectives” for the developing legislation. Johnson said he is already in ongoing talks with House Budget Chair Jodey Arrington (R-Texas), who is planning to advance a fiscal blueprint for the GOP-only bill as soon as this week. Some Republicans are eyeing billions of dollars in savings from targeting purported fraud in Medicare, Medicaid and other social programs to offset any new spending. Johnson said he hasn’t seen a draft of the House budget blueprint, which must be adopted in both chambers to unlock the party-line reconciliation process, but expects to be in touch with Arrington and White House officials as the process progresses. “It's a team sport,” he said. “I just want to do everything I can to organize the effort so we can succeed.” Johnson said he is also vetting a House proposal related to voter-ID legislation from Rep. Bryan Steil , the fellow Wisconsin Republican who leads the House panel overseeing election matters. If found to comply with strict reconciliation rules, it could serve to partially sidestep the Democratic filibuster of the SAVE America Act — the GOP elections bill that Trump has repeatedly pushed Congress to pass. “I've already given that to Budget Committee staff to kind of get their opinion on it,” Johnson said of Steil’s proposal. “I mean, in the end, it's going to be the parliamentarian that rules.”

snippet: I'm convinced that you might know someone who went to Ikea for a lamp and came home three hours later with a car full of flat-pack boxes they didn't plan on buying. That's the Ikea effect. It's as if the maze-like stores are designed to make you forget you drove 45 minutes to get there. That's also precisely the problem Ikea was trying to solve in 2023 when it launched its smaller "Plan & Order Point with Pick-up" locations. Yes, the idea was smart: bringing Ikea closer to metro shoppers who weren't willing to make the pilgrimage to the warehouse. TheStreet reported that on Aug. 30, 2026, Ikea will close two of those locations. One in South Charlotte, North Carolina, and one in Austin, Texas, according to its website . The Swedish retailer spent billions building the format it's now walking away from. And when a giant retreats from a market, of course, someone else fills the space. My understanding is that Target ( TGT ) is the most obvious beneficiary. In fact, the timing couldn't be better for a retailer that just posted its strongest quarter in years. Also Read: History of Target: Company timeline and facts Why Ikea's retreat leaves a real gap in two major markets Let me be clear about what these closures actually mean. These weren't full Ikea warehouse stores. They were smaller service hubs designed to help customers plan purchases and pick up orders. Essentially, it was a direct attempt to capture urban and suburban shoppers who weren't making the trip to the big-box locations. That's an important distinction. Ikea was using these locations to reach a specific kind of shopper. The apartment renters, young professionals, and first-time homeowners who want Scandinavian-style, budget-friendly design without the day-trip commitment. Related: IKEA closing key U.S. stores In Charlotte and Austin — two of the fastest-growing metro areas in the country — that demographic is enormous. Ikea Family membership data tells the story clearly. In fiscal year 2025, 25 million U.S. members generated 56% of all U.S. sales, with an average order value of $183 compared to $90 for non-members, according to Ikea U.S. FY25 Annual Summary. These are loyal, high-spending customers. Closing the access points that brought them closer to the brand doesn't make those shoppers disappear. snippet: Over the past 18 months, TheStreet has closely covered Ford's persistent quality control issues and the progress it has made. Last year, Ford blew away the record for most recalls in a year , surpassing rival GM 's more than decade-old record by the summer of 2025. Ford CEO Jim Farley and his lieutenants have spoken about quality control on earnings calls and done interviews about what they are doing to improve the quality of their vehicles. But in all the interviews and quotes from the company and Farley, I had never heard the term "Gembas." Farley mentioned Gembas during his recent interview with the Detroit News, calling them "one of the first things I did as a CEO." He credits them with helping turn Ford's quality fortunes around, so it's worth exploring what they are. Ford CEO uses "Gemba" walks to reboot manufacturing quality Ford's quality control issues have been known to the company for years. In 2023, Ford said it spent $4.8 billion fixing customer vehicles. So CEO Jim Farley is taking a more hands-on approach, visiting over a dozen plants in just the past year. Farley is using a Japanese tool he learned while working for Toyota in the '80s, and it's called a "Gemba." In Japanese, Gemba means "actual place," according to 4 Industry . In the business context, it is a staple of a lean management philosophy that beckons leaders to the factory floor to observe processes, engage with employees, and discover opportunities for improvement. "When we decided to build a new plant, it was a common expectation at Toyota, even if you were a Westerner, to spend time in the plant," Farley said in his interview with Detroit News . "I watched very senior people at Toyota in Japan go to the line, find problems, go to the operator who is dealing with the problem, and then try to problem-solve to help the team." Farley says that when he became CEO of Ford, the company was 25th in initial quality. But he is using the lessons he learned about "servant leadership" from his Toyota days to gradually turn that around. Now, he is fine-tuning his Gembas to address more specific issues. headline: 9 nations back Ukraine’s Patriot alternative, Freyja — and want it flying in a year
triage_reason: Nine nations support Ukraine's Patriot alternative Freyja, aiming for operational status within a year
snippet: KYIV, Ukraine — Nine nations have joined Ukraine in a nascent anti-ballistic coalition to speed up production of Ukraine’s Freyja interceptor system and get it operational within a year, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced at a meeting of defense allies in France on Monday. He first said a coalition of allies would work together to build the complicated weapon at last week’s NATO summit in Ankara, where U.S. President Donald Trump pledged to let Ukraine build its own Patriot interceptors after recognizing that, in Zelenskyy’s words, Ukraine is “a country that is ready to do this.” The initiative was launched as a result of a global shortage of anti-ballistic interceptors, as the war in Iran and nearby countries carries on into its fifth month and allied partners across the world push to stock up on defensive weapons. Nine European countries joined Ukraine as founding members in Paris: Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, Sweden and the United Kingdom. “We believe that the protection of Europe requires a global solution of integrated missile defence architecture to deter and defeat future missile threats — developed through collective effort, technological openness, and trusted industrial cooperation,” officials wrote in the joint statement formalizing the new coalition. Although the United States has increased Patriot output and Europe has expanded production of the surface-to-air missile systems SAMP/T, IRIS-T and NASAMS, the shortfall between demand and supply is still wide. “By bringing together our defence industrial base, our research, and our operational experience, we aim to build a shared antiballistic missile capacity for Europe and support relevant contributory activities. We do this not against any people, but in defence of our own,” the signatories said. For Ukraine, gaining antiballistic capabilities would enable better protection of its cities and frontlines, both which have increasingly been targeted by Russian ballistic missiles that cannot be taken out by air defenses — and free them from completely depending on allies for this type of support. For Europe, the coalition offers a fast-tracked path to resolving weapons shortages, strengthening their own defenses at a discount and benefiting from the battlefield expertise Ukraine has gained over years of full-scale war. headline: Gobi X: Creating more energy for AI, not taking it from society
triage_reason: Gobi X announces more energy for AI without societal impact
snippet: The hardest problem in AI is no longer the chip but the megawatt. For much of the past three years, the global AI race has focused on semiconductors, with governments competing for advanced chips, technology outfits scrambling to secure GPUs, and investors pouring billions into ever larger datacenters. Yet the binding constraint has shifted from compute to the power required to run it. For anyone trying to energize a new AI cluster today, the bottleneck is rarely silicon; it is grid access, interconnection delays, and aging infrastructure. That was the central message from Envision founder and CEO Lei Zhang at VivaTech in Paris this June, where he argued that AI amounts to an energy revolution as much as a computing one. The steam engine transformed the industrial age by converting coal into motion, and the GPU now transforms the AI age by converting electricity into intelligence. History offers another lesson: James Watt changed industry through the efficient use of energy rather than by producing more steam. AI faces the same problem today, because the binding constraint has shifted from how many chips can be built to how they can be powered. The real risk: AI competing with society for energy The numbers behind the argument are stark. Goldman puts US datacenter power demand at 31 GW in 2025, rising to 66 GW by 2027, while assuming only about 72 percent of scheduled facilities arrive on time because electricity, not construction, is what typically slips. The IEA estimates that datacenters consumed roughly 1.5 percent of world electricity in 2024, a share rising to 3 percent by 2030 as AI-specific demand triples. The structural mismatch sits at the heart of the problem: AI models iterate every six months and chips refresh annually, while power grids have changed little in decades. Rack densities that sat at 5 kW are climbing toward 200 kW, and the IEA notes that AI server power density rose elevenfold between 2020 and 2025, with a further fourfold rise expected by 2027, straining the supply chains for power electronics and transformers that keep a cluster stable. The growing gap raises broader questions about where the energy will come from and who will bear the cost. snippet: 쿠팡은 인기 생필품 특가 상품을 한데 모은 '여름 생필품 페어'를 오는 19일까지 진행한다고 밝혔다. 이번 행사에는 세탁 및 청소 세제부터 헤어, 바디 용품, 위생용품에 이르기까지 총 80여 개의 주요 브랜드가 참여해 대규모 라인업을 구축했다. 이번 기획전의 핵심은 여름철과 장마 시즌에 급증하는 소비자 수요를 정조준했다는 점이다. 땀 배출이 많아 세탁 횟수가 늘어나는 계절적 요인을 고려해 다양한 세탁세제와 섬유유연제를 전면에 배치했다. 특히 습도가 높은 장마철의 고질적인 문제인 빨래 냄새를 해결할 실내 건조 전용 세제와 향기 부스터 제품군을 풍성하게 준비해 선택의 폭을 넓혔다. 주요 참여 브랜드를 살펴보면 비트와 위칙 등 세탁 전문 브랜드를 포함해 엘라스틴, 려 등 헤어케어 브랜드가 이름을 올렸다. 유시몰과 텐티본조르노 등 구강용품과 이너시아, 템포 등 여성용품 브랜드도 합류해 일상생활 전반에 필요한 품목을 망라했다. 대표적인 특가 상품으로는 비트 진드기 침투세탁 액상세제(3L)를 9000원대에, 엘라스틴 프로틴 클리닉 고영양 단백질 트리트먼트(1L)를 1만1000원대에 판매한다. 구취 제거에 효과적인 텐티본조르노 아쿠아민트향 치약 3개 묶음은 7000원대라는 합리적인 가격에 책정됐다. 강한 자외선으로 손상되기 쉬운 두피 관리를 위한 상품군도 강화했다. 에이플러스랩 맥주효모 탈모증상완화 샴푸를 4000원대에, 려 함빛 극손상 앤 영양 탈모증상완화 샴푸를 8000원대에 선보이며 여름철 뷰티 케어 수요에 대응하고 있다. 쿠팡은 유료 멤버십인 와우회원을 위해 추가 할인 혜택을 설계하며 충성 고객 우대 정책을 이어간다. 행사 상품을 일정 금액 이상 구매할 경우 금액대별로 차등화된 할인 쿠폰을 적용받을 수 있다. 쿠팡 관계자는 "여름철과 장마 시즌을 맞아 고객들에게 꼭 필요한 인기 생필품들을 엄선했다"며 "이번 기획전이 소비자들의 쾌적한 여름나기에 실질적인 도움이 되기를 기대한다"고 설명했다. 비지니스코리아 김황민 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 엔카, 7월 중고차 브랜드평판 1위 수성.. 케이카·KB차차차 추격
triage_reason: Encar ranks first in July used‑car brand reputation.
snippet: 엔카가 2026년 7월 중고차 브랜드평판 조사에서 1위를 차지하며 시장 지배력을 다시 한번 입증했다. 한국기업평판연구소는 지난 6월 14일부터 한 달간 14개 중고차 브랜드의 빅데이터 756만2021개를 정밀 분석했다. 이는 전월 대비 0.16% 소폭 감소한 수치이나, 브랜드 간 순위 경쟁은 여전히 치열한 양상을 보였다. 평판지수는 참여·미디어·소통·커뮤니티·사회공헌 등 5개 항목을 종합해 산출했다. 출처:한국기업평판연구소 엔카는 브랜드평판지수 312만4465를 기록하며 압도적인 점수로 1위 자리를 지켰다. 전월 대비 지수는 5.51% 하락했으나 참여지수와 미디어지수 등 전 항목에서 고른 점수를 획득했다. 2위 케이카는 117만7022를 기록하며 선전했고, KB차차차는 92만2571로 3위에 이름을 올렸다. 주목할 만한 변화는 4위 헤이딜러의 약진이다. 헤이딜러는 평판지수 75만3285를 기록하며 지난달보다 45.13%라는 가파른 상승폭을 보였다. 공격적인 마케팅과 사용자 편의성을 강조한 서비스가 커뮤니티와 소셜 미디어상에서 긍정적인 반응을 이끌어낸 것으로 풀이된다. 국내 중고차 시장은 가파른 성장세를 이어가고 있다. 2022년 30조원 규모였던 시장은 2024년 40조원대로 확대됐으며, 최근에는 경기 둔화와 고금리 여파로 신차 대신 중고차를 찾는 합리적 소비자가 늘고 있다. 가계 부담이 커지면서 중고차 수요가 급증하는 반사 이익을 누리는 셈이다. 해외 수출 시장의 활성화도 시장 규모를 키우는 핵심 동력으로 작용하고 있다. 한국 중고차에 대한 글로벌 수요가 증가하며 국내 기업들의 사업 영역이 확장되는 추세다. 업계 관계자는 "단순한 중고차 매매를 넘어 디지털 트랜스포메이션을 통한 투명한 정보 공개가 브랜드 평판을 결정짓는 핵심 요소가 됐다"고 설명했다. 이번 평판 분석 결과는 소비자의 온라인 습관이 실제 브랜드 소비에 직결된다는 점을 시사한다. 5위를 기록한 리본카를 비롯해 카모아, 오토벨 등 중위권 브랜드들도 디지털 접점을 넓히며 점유율 확대를 꾀하고 있다. 브랜드에 대한 긍부정 평가와 미디어 관심도가 시장 점유율에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 구조다. 전문가들은 중고차 시장의 대형화와 기업화가 가속화될 것으로 전망하고 있다. 한 시장 분석가는 "소비자들은 허위 매물에 대한 불안감을 해소해 주는 브랜드에 높은 점수를 준다"며 "향후 사회공헌과 소통지수를 얼마나 관리하느냐가 장기적인 브랜드 가치를 결정할 것"이라고 강조했다. 비지니스코리아 허성수 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 부커스, 전자책 제작 사업 출범..."기획부터 유통까지 통합 생태계 구축"
triage_reason: Bookers launches an e‑book production business to build an integrated ecosystem.
snippet: B2B 전자책 구독 플랫폼 부커스(대표 임동명)가 전자책 제작 사업을 신규 사업으로 공식 출범하며 디지털 콘텐츠 산업 전반을 아우르는 사업 확장에 나선다고 14일 밝혔다. 부커스는 최근 출판 사업 진출을 통해 자체 콘텐츠 기획 역량을 확보한 데 이어 제작 분야까지 사업 영역을 넓혔다. 특히 전자책 제작 분야 전문가인 내맘대로출판사 박웅영 대표와 협업 체계를 구축하며 제작 품질 고도화와 기술 경쟁력 확보에 속도를 내고 있다. 이는 콘텐츠 생산부터 소비까지 이어지는 수직계열화를 통해 운영 효율성을 극대화하려는 포석이다. 사업의 핵심 거점은 전남광주통합특별시 동구에 위치한 전일빌딩245다. 부커스는 이곳에 전자책 제작 전문 조직을 꾸리고 전문 인력을 채용해 업무를 수행하고 있으며, 향후 증가하는 수요에 맞춰 인력 규모를 지속적으로 확대할 계획이다. 지역 기반의 디지털 콘텐츠 기술 개발 거점을 육성함으로써 지역 경제 활성화에도 기여한다는 방침이다. 부커스의 제작 사업은 일반 출판사를 넘어 정부, 지방자치단체, 공공기관, 기업 등 전 분야를 타깃으로 삼는다. 정부 및 지자체의 정책자료와 연구보고서, 공공기관의 교육자료, 기업의 ESG 보고서와 사사(社史) 등 다양한 발간물을 표준 전자책 형태로 제작할 예정이다. 단순 PDF 변환을 넘어 다양한 기기 환경에서 최적화된 이용자 경험을 제공하는 것이 핵심이다. 한국출판문화산업진흥원이 추진하는 전자책 제작지원사업 수행은 물론 민간 출판사의 종이책 전자화 사업도 폭넓게 지원한다. 최근 공공과 민간을 가리지 않고 디지털 전환이 가속화되면서 표준 전자책 제작 수요가 급증하는 추세다. 부커스는 플랫폼 운영을 통해 축적한 콘텐츠 검수 경험과 뷰어 호환성 검증 노하우를 제작 과정에 직접 반영해 차별화된 경쟁력을 선보일 것으로 보인다. 제작 기술 측면에서는 HTML5와 CSS3 기반의 EPUB 국제 표준을 철저히 준수한다. 제작 프로세스 표준화와 출판사별 템플릿 구축을 통해 제작 기간과 비용을 절감하는 한편, 향후 자동화 기술을 접목해 효율성을 높일 계획이다. 이러한 기술적 성과는 다시 플랫폼 서비스 개선으로 이어지는 선순환 구조를 형성하게 된다. 현재 국내 전자책 시장은 기획, 제작, 유통이 분절된 구조로 운영되는 경우가 많다. 부커스는 기존 구독형 플랫폼 사업과 신규 제작·출판 사업을 유기적으로 연결해 통합 사업 구조를 구축하고 있다. 이를 통해 단순 플랫폼 기업에서 탈피해 디지털 콘텐츠 통합 기업으로 도약하겠다는 구상이다. 임동명 부커스 대표는 "전자책 시장의 지속 성장을 위해서는 콘텐츠 제작과 유통, 서비스가 유기적으로 연결된 생태계가 필수적이다"라고 강조했다. 이어 "제작과 기술, 플랫폼을 아우르는 통합 역량을 바탕으로 글로벌 시장에서도 경쟁력 있는 생태계를 구축해 나갈 것"이라고 덧붙였다. 비지니스코리아 이송훈 기자 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: 한국서부발전, 발전소 환경 데이터 실시간 공개
triage_reason: Korea West Power releases real‑time environmental data from its power plants.
snippet: 한국서부발전은 발전소 환경정보 전용 모바일 애플리케이션인 '위드에코(We Do Eco)-한국서부발전 환경정보공개'를 정식 출시했다고 14일 밝혔다. 이번 앱 출시는 발전시설이 환경에 미치는 영향에 대해 높아진 국민적 관심과 정보 공개 요구에 부응하기 위해 기획됐다. 앱 명칭인 위드에코는 '우리가 실천하는 환경'이라는 의미와 함께 서부발전(Western Power)의 앞 글자를 따서 명명됐다. 회사와 국민이 함께 환경 보호를 실천하고 그 과정을 투명하게 공유하겠다는 의지를 담았으며 구글 플레이스토어와 애플 앱스토어를 통해 누구나 무료로 내려받을 수 있다. 사진은 '위드에코 한국서부발전 환경정보공개' 앱 갈무리 이용자는 앱을 통해 각 사업소별 대기오염물질 자동측정기기(TMS) 측정값을 실시간으로 확인할 수 있다. 아울러 발전소 운영에 투입되는 용수와 에너지 사용량 등 주요 환경 지표도 가감 없이 공개된다. 단순 수치 나열에 그치지 않고 카드뉴스와 영상 콘텐츠를 배치해 전문 지식이 없는 일반인도 정보를 쉽게 이해하도록 구성한 점이 특징이다. 소통 기능도 대폭 강화했다. 앱 내 환경 게시판을 설치해 사용자가 환경 관련 궁금증을 문의하거나 의견을 직접 전달할 수 있는 창구를 마련했다. 서부발전은 이번 앱 출시가 친환경 에너지 전환을 추진하는 과정에서 지역사회와 국민의 신뢰를 얻는 핵심 동력이 될 것으로 기대하고 있다. 투명한 정보 공개를 통해 발전소 운영에 대한 막연한 불안감을 해소하고 객관적인 데이터를 바탕으로 한 소통 체계를 구축한다는 방침이다. 이정복 서부발전 사장은 "환경정보를 투명하게 공개해 국민의 알 권리를 보장하고 발전소 운영에 대한 신뢰를 높이겠다"며 "앞으로도 공개 대상 정보를 지속적으로 확대하고 데이터 품질을 개선해 국민과 더욱 적극적으로 소통하겠다"고 강조했다. 비지니스코리아 이광수 (pr@businesskorea.co.kr)

headline: NHRC Takes Suo Motu Cognizance Over Deadly Oxygen Cylinder Blast In Raipur Factory
triage_reason: NHRC takes suo motu cognizance of a deadly oxygen cylinder blast in a Raipur factory.
snippet: The National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), India has taken suo motu cognizance of a media report that at least three workers died and several others were injured in an explosion at a factory situated in the Urla industrial area of Raipur, Chhattisgarh on 7th June 2026. The explosion was allegedly caused due to the bursting of an oxygen cylinder in the factory. Human Rights Violation Flagged The Commission has observed that the contents of the news report, if true, raise serious issues of violation of human rights. Therefore, it has issued notices to the Chhattisgarh Chief Secretary and Director General of Police, calling for a detailed report on the matter within two weeks. The report is expected to include the status of health of the injured, as well as compensation, if any, paid to the next of kin of the deceased and the injured. headline: Mumbai Metro Line 5 Extension To Ulhasnagar To Be Completed In 48 Months; MMRDA Invites Bids For Next Phases
triage_reason: Announcement of metro line extension and bid invitation, no immediate financial impact.
snippet: Mumbai, July 13, 2026: Following approval for the extension of Metro Line 5 to Ulhasnagar, the authorities have initiated preparations for the construction of the new metro corridor. The Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA) has begun the process of appointing a contractor to undertake the construction of the metro line from Dhamankar Naka in Bhiwandi to Ulhasnagar. On July 11, MMRDA invited bids for the civil works related to the metro viaduct and station construction for Phase II and Phase III of Metro Line 5. According to the tender conditions, the successful bidder will be required to complete the work within 48 months. headline: Burhanpur Boy Walks Again With Robotic Limbs After Surviving High-Voltage Shock
triage_reason: Human‑interest medical story, no market impact.
snippet: Indore (Madhya Pradesh): In a remarkable feat of medical care, a multidisciplinary team at Shri Aurobindo Hospital has helped a six-year-old boy regain mobility and independence after a devastating high-voltage electric shock left him with life-threatening injuries. After eight months of treatment and rehabilitation, Manthan Adolkar from Shahpur in Burhanpur district can now walk and perform daily activities with the help of robotic prosthetic limbs. Doctors said Manthan suffered severe electrical burns in December last year after coming into contact with a high-tension power line while playing on a rooftop. The injuries were so extensive that both arms had to be amputated from the shoulder and his left leg from the hip to save his life. After initial treatment locally, he was referred to Shri Aurobindo Hospital incritical condition. Paediatric surgeon Dr Advait Prakash said the child was treated using advanced technology and modern medical equipment. Shri Aurobindo Group Founder Chairman Dr Vinod Bhandari took up the case as a challenge and arranged imported robotic prosthetic limbs. Despite delays caused by the Iran-US conflict affecting international logistics, the hospital ensured the devices reached India. A team of plastic surgeons, orthopaedic specialists, paediatricians, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, psychiatrists, psychologists and anaesthesiologists worked together to restore the child's functional abilities. The hospital also bore the treatment costs after the family's Ayushman Bharat insurance cover was exhausted. Doctors said Manthan can now walk, eat independently and has regained movement in his artificial elbow, wrist and fingers, marking a major milestone in his recovery. ₹52 Lakh Liquor Haul Bound For Gujarat Seized In Indore

headline: Bombay HC Raps State Govt Over 'Callous, Lethargic' Delay In Implementing Forest Rights Act, Seeks Timeline
triage_reason: Court criticism of state implementation of forest rights, no direct investment impact.
snippet: Mumbai, July 13, 2026: The Bombay High Court has termed the Maharashtra government's failure to effectively implement the Forest Rights Act for nearly two decades as a result of "sheer callousness" and a "lethargic attitude". It has directed the state to explain the delay and specify when it will enforce the law. PIL Challenges Delay A bench of Justices Ajey Gadkari and Kamal Khata made the observations while hearing a public interest litigation filed by NGO Vanashakti, which has sought effective implementation of the Forest Rights Act in the state. The Act, enacted in 2006, recognises the rights of forest-dwelling Scheduled Tribes and other traditional forest dwellers over forest land and resources. It provides for Individual Forest Rights (IFR) for cultivation and habitation, as well as Community Forest Resource (CFR) rights that allow communities to protect, manage and sustainably use forest resources. The bench noted that despite the law being in force for nearly two decades, its provisions have still not been effectively implemented in Maharashtra. "It is an admitted fact on record that, till date, the 2006 Act has not been properly, rather effectively, implemented in the State of Maharashtra," the court observed. It added that the state had been offering "various excuses" instead of complying with the mandatory provisions of the law. Court Rejects State's Explanation The judges also pointed out that the PIL has been pending since April 7, 2014, and yet the government had failed to provide any satisfactory explanation for the delay. "For over 12 years, except giving numerous excuses, no cogent and sufficient reason is given for not implementing the mandatory provisions of the said Act," the bench said. During the hearing, counsel for the state submitted that the process of identifying and deciding the rights of tribals was still underway. The court, however, rejected the explanation, observing that determining such rights should not take more than a decade. "We are unable to accept such a submission... It certainly does not take more than a decade to decide such rights. It is sheer callousness and lethargic attitude on the part of the concerned authorities. Such conduct is unacceptable," the bench said. snippet: Mumbai, July 13, 2026: The Bombay High Court has ruled that a Co-operative Court can add a person as a party to a dispute even if they are not among those listed under Section 91 of the Maharashtra Co-operative Societies Act, as long as their presence is necessary to decide the case properly. HC Upholds Impleadment Order Justice Sandeep Marne made the observation while dismissing a petition filed by members of Bramha Suncity Co-operative Housing Society Ltd. and others, challenging the orders of the Co-operative Court and the Co-operative Appellate Court allowing a developer, Bramha Corporation Ltd., to be added as a party to the dispute. The society, situated at Wadgaonsheri, Pune, is formed in respect of 26 buildings comprising 1,277 members. The dispute arose after the petitioners challenged resolutions passed by the society's Special General Body and Managing Committee accepting a settlement proposal with the developer. The members claimed the resolutions significantly reduced the society's entitlement to land and alleged there was collusion between the society's office-bearers and the developer. Although the dispute was originally filed only against the society and its former office-bearers, the developer sought to be added as a party, arguing that serious allegations had been made against it and that its presence was necessary for the court to decide the matter properly. Both the Co-operative Court and the Co-operative Appellate Court accepted the request. Court Interprets Section 94 Before the High Court, the petitioners argued that the developer was a stranger to the dispute and was not covered under the categories of persons mentioned in Section 91 of the Act. The developer contended that Section 94(3)(c) gives the Co-operative Court wider powers to add any person whose presence is necessary for deciding the dispute. Agreeing with the developer, Justice Marne held that Section 94(3)(c) is an independent provision and is not limited by Section 91. "The Court cannot give a narrow or restrictive meaning to the language used in Section 94(3)(c)," the judge said, adding that the provision allows the Co-operative Court to implead "any person whose presence… may be necessary" for effective adjudication. A separate stretch from Charoti to Vadhvan Port will be developed by the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI), creating seamless connectivity to the upcoming deep-sea port. snippet: Navi Mumbai, July 13, 2026: In one of the biggest crackdowns on the illegal tobacco trade in the region, the Navi Mumbai Police Crime Branch has seized banned gutkha and scented pan masala worth over Rs 1.05 crore from Taloja and arrested three persons allegedly involved in the interstate supply network. Crime Branch Busts Gutkha Racket Acting on specific intelligence, Crime Branch Unit-1 raided a warehouse at Batli Compound in Dharna village, Taloja, on Friday and caught workers transferring cartons of banned gutkha from an Eicher truck into two Maruti Suzuki Super Carry tempos. During the operation, police seized Premium Rajnivas scented pan masala and Premium ZN-1 Zafrani Jarda worth Rs 64.60 lakh, along with three goods vehicles valued at Rs 40 lakh, taking the total seizure to Rs 1,05,63,000. The arrested accused have been identified as Karan Ram Salunkhe, Darshan alias Jaggu Omprakash Kumar and Vinodkumar Prabhuram Prajapati. During interrogation, Salunkhe allegedly disclosed the location of another stockpile concealed in a warehouse at Nilkamal Residency in Ghot Camp, Taloja. A follow-up raid led to the seizure of an additional consignment of banned gutkha and pan masala worth Rs 16 lakh. Probe Into Supply Network Police said the contraband had been brought to Taloja for distribution across Navi Mumbai and Mumbai. A case has been registered at Taloja Police Station against seven accused under the relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Food Safety and Standards Act. While three accused have been arrested, efforts are underway to trace the remaining four absconding suspects. The operation was carried out by Senior Police Inspector Vikas Ghodke, Assistant Police Inspector Nileshkumar Mahadik, Police Sub-Inspector Pradeep Borude and the Crime Branch Unit-1 team. "Based on credible intelligence, we intercepted a large consignment of banned gutkha before it could reach the retail market. headline: What This Block Insider Sale Means as Cash App Gross Profit Jumped 38%
triage_reason: Block insider sale indicates a share transaction; cash‑app gross profit jump suggests positive operational news.
snippet: Anthony Mathew Eisen, a director at Block, Inc. (NYSE:XYZ) , sold 18,000 shares of Class A Common Stock between July 9, 2026 and July 13, 2026, according to an SEC Form 4 filing . Block, Inc. operates as a leading infrastructure software provider in the payments ecosystem, with TTM revenues of $24.5 billion and a market capitalization of roughly $46 billion. The company leverages its integrated hardware and software platform to deliver comprehensive payment solutions that address merchant needs for transaction processing, financial analytics, and working capital optimization. Block's competitive positioning is strengthened by its end-to-end payment infrastructure, next-day settlement capabilities, and robust reporting analytics that differentiate its offerings in the competitive payments technology sector. This sale ultimately looks like a co-founder trimming a corner of a very large position, not a signal about where Block is headed. Eisen sold on a plan set back in March, and 18,000 shares barely dents the roughly 1.8 million he still holds, worth about $145 million. Eisen co-founded Afterpay, the buy-now-pay-later business Block acquired in 2021, so his stake reflects a company he helped build. When someone with nine figures still on the table sells a fraction of a percent on a preset schedule, the tax-and-diversification read is the honest one. Meanwhile, the business is running well beneath a somewhat messy headline, with shares seesawing recently and settling about 15% up for the year. Block's first-quarter gross profit rose 27% to $2.91 billion, led by 38% growth at Cash App, and adjusted operating income hit a record $728 million. Management raised full-year gross-profit guidance to $12.33 billion, and CEO Jack Dorsey leaned into AI tools like MoneyBot as the next growth lever. The firm is planning to report second-quarter earnings on August 5. For long-term investors, the sale is noise, but the GAAP-versus-adjusted gap is worth understanding. Block posted a $309 million net loss on restructuring and bitcoin charges even as the underlying business accelerated, so it’ll be important to see whether Cash App's momentum holds as its lending boom normalizes.
